name: Mohammad Sohail Qureshi
title: Full-Stack Engineer
summary: Lead Full-Stack Engineer with 10 years of experience designing, developing, and delivering enterprise applications across Banking & Financial Services, Telecom, Healthcare, and Insurance. Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Angular, React, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, and SQL, with hands-on experience across application architecture, technical design, performance optimization, and full-stack development. Also an open-source developer and creator of TokenWise, an NPM-based LLM token optimization toolkit.
